summary: Lemhi County, ID cabin on the west point (about 1934), destroyed in the 1950s; no source describes what remains; a 1934 Decker item is also credited to a different Horse Heaven whose history matches the Idaho County register entry.

facts.design: Cabin on the west point (about 1934); no tower
facts.status_note: Destroyed in the 1950s per sources; no source describes what remains at the site

visit.trail_note: Labelled hike-in by Idaho Fire Lookouts

events.note: Cabin atop the west point; Forest Lookouts dates it c.1934
Destroyed in the 1950s; sources give no exact year

evidence.supports: cabin atop the west point, 1934; destroyed in the 1950s
1934 Recorder Herald item: Ivan Decker en route to his lookout at Horse Heaven (no county named)
evidence.quote: Ivan Decker a former member of this company and a student of forestry at the University of Idaho, was a visitor over the weekend, Decker, who is en route to his lookout at Horse Heaven

evidence.supports: Idaho Fire Lookouts lists the 1934 Decker (Recorder Herald) entry at its West Central Horse Heaven; the page names no county
West Central Horse Heaven history: 1929 log cabin
West Central Horse Heaven history: 1931 30-foot pole tower with 7x7 cab, same as the Idaho County register entry
Idaho County Horse Heaven register dates: 1929 cabin, 1931 tower, removed 1950
evidence.quote: Starting with a log cabin in 1929, a 30' pole tower with 7x7' cab was built in 1931, and removed in 1950.

notes_for_editor: The brief record (Lemhi County, Salmon National Forest, cabin) is supported by firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts Salmon listing. The brief's coordinates appear in no source we read; by rough arithmetic they fit '32 miles WNW of Salmon', so treat them as unverified. Elevation 8,086 ft appears on this Lemhi listing and on the Idaho County tower alike, so it is not used. The 1934 Decker item is credited by name to a Horse Heaven without a county: Forest Lookouts places it with the Salmon listing, while Idaho Fire Lookouts' West Central page (Payette NF listing, 1929 cabin, 1931 tower, 1950 destroyed) matches the Idaho County register entry but does not name the county. us-id-horse-heaven.md (Idaho County) cites the same item and should be reconciled with this one. No staffing is attributed to this tower. No photos checked.
